Author: ShaalaXIV
Name: EmoteLink
Description: A plain Penumbra animation launcher with temporary activation, target alignment, and synchronized group play.
Punchline: Pick an emote, link up, and play together.
Changelog: Indexes all Penumbra changed-item emotes against the game emote sheet and exposes every recognized trigger with its name, ID, Ready/Activate control, and Solo control alongside detected pose roles.
